statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail rises one point to 16 inside the low band after the August Empire State survey printed 20.6 against roughly 11 expected, a four-year high. The upside surprise is an evidence-rich Stress and Confidence input; with only a delayed 12:07Z futures quote available, no post-release price path has been observed and no mean-reversion failure is in evidence.
recommendation: Conditions remain consistent with a mean-reverting regime carrying a modest upward tilt into a hot data print. NQ was 30,256.25 on the most recent delayed quote, about 0.38% above the 30,141.75 prior settlement and inside a narrow 30,163.75-30,343.00 overnight band. The August Empire State index at 20.6, versus about 11 expected and 15.6 prior, is the session's dominant new fact, with accelerating input prices and a worsening supply-availability subindex adding a mildly hawkish tint alongside a US 10-year near 4.71%. Because the post-release path is not yet observable, event magnitude is scored into Stress at 66 and Confidence at 84 rather than into Tail, which lifts only one point to 16. The mapped policy state is EA_ON. A narrow danger window is retained across the US cash open and the first cash hour, where opening-auction continuation with shallow pullbacks would first become observable.
headline: Empire State jumps to a four-year high of 20.6 in August while NQ futures near 30,256.25 hold the upper half of a narrow overnight band, with the VIX around 14.92 and the 10-year near 4.71%
body:
NQ futures were 30,256.25 on a 12:07Z delayed quote, up about 114.5 points or 0.38% on the 30,141.75 prior settlement and inside an observed overnight band of roughly 30,163.75-30,343.00, a span of about 0.6%. The defining development of this hour is the 12:30Z release of the August Empire State Manufacturing Survey, whose general business conditions index rose five points to 20.6, its highest reading in more than four years, against a consensus near 11 and a prior of 15.6. New orders came in at 17.3, unfilled orders rose eleven points, input price increases accelerated and supply availability worsened to -13.4, while the future business conditions index climbed to 32.1. That combination is growth-positive but mildly hawkish at the margin, which is consistent with a US 10-year yield near 4.71% and a 2-year near 4.18%.

The critical qualification is that no price path after the release is yet observable. The best available futures quote predates the print, so the survey is scored as event magnitude rather than as structural evidence. Under the governing risk definition, a large upside surprise raises the probability of a difficult, volatile session far more than it raises the probability of a persistent no-retracement path, and Tail therefore lifts only one point to 16 while Stress moves to 66.

Corroborating evidence is genuinely two-sided. Delayed cross-asset context shows NQ leading at about +0.44% with S&P futures near +0.11% and Dow futures negative near -0.21%, a disagreement that argues for dispersion rather than a single efficient directional regime. Latest-session sector detail shows semiconductors and semiconductor equipment firmly positive while application and infrastructure software are negative, and megacap breadth is five positive against three negative with dispersion of only 0.64 points. The VIX at 14.92 against a 14.25 prior close is higher on the day but confined to a 14.89-15.00 range, which is not volatility expansion. Crude is contained, with WTI near $82.74 and Brent near $89.12.

Geopolitics remains the principal unresolved discontinuity risk rather than an active path driver. Transit through the Strait of Hormuz has slowed to a near standstill after attacks on three ADNOC-operated vessels, with five commodity vessels recorded on Saturday and none on Sunday against 31 the previous weekend, and US-Iran talks have stalled. Crude's muted response indicates the market is not currently pricing a physical supply outage, so this is scored into Stress and into headline gap risk rather than into the current Tail path. The separate AI-credit theme, in which heavy technology issuance is estimated to have added roughly 0.3 percentage points to the 10-year this year, is a slow valuation driver rather than an hourly mechanism.

The narrow danger window spans 13:15Z to 14:45Z, covering the 13:30Z cash open, the opening auction and the 14:00Z NAHB release. That is the first interval in which opening-auction continuation, shallow pullbacks or repeated extension after failed retracements could actually be observed. Absent such evidence, Tail remains well below the blocking threshold and the mapped policy state stays EA_ON.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding clock-hours carry a published Claude assessment. Tail stayed inside the low band for the entire window, ranging from 12 to 17, with the mapped policy state EA_ON throughout. Stress peaked at 82 during Sunday's US-hours window while Gulf conflict and crude headlines dominated, then decayed steadily to 64 by the final hour as the tape compressed and crude faded from its highs. Confidence improved from 76 to 84, with a temporary dip to 68 across the thin Sunday evening hours, as live futures pricing, volatility, rates and calendar evidence became progressively better corroborated. Dominant mode was mixed through the active sessions and normal across the quiet overnight stretch, and at no point in the window was a persistent no-retracement path observed.
outlookSummary: The conditional path keeps Tail inside the low band across all 24 forecast hours, with the mapped policy state EA_ON throughout. Conditional risk holds at 16 in the current hour, lifts to 17 into the 13:00Z hour containing the US cash open, and peaks at 18 across the 14:00Z hour that covers the first full cash hour and the NAHB release, which is the point at which opening-auction continuation with shallow pullbacks would first become observable. It then decays through the US afternoon as opening imbalances clear, lifts one point into the 19:00Z power hour where late-session flow can be directionally efficient, and falls to a window minimum of 12 across the thin post-close and Asian hours. It drifts back to 15 into Tuesday's European midday ahead of the 12:30Z housing releases. Stress eases from 66 to a low of 57 overnight before rebuilding to 64, and Confidence decays gradually from 84 to 73 with forecast distance, which reflects horizon rather than any weakness in the current evidence base.
